
# Supplementary Figure 5 - segmentation data analysis

# +++ Setup

## Libraries

Load necessary libraries for data analysis and plotting.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(conflicted)
library(gcplyr)
library(egg)

library(ggpubr)
library(colorspace)

library(readxl) 
library(writexl)

# Solve conflicts between packages with the same function names
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("combine", "dplyr")
```

## Base directories

```{r}
## ______________________________________________________
# Set home directory
dir_home = "~/directory"

# Set data directories
dir_input = file.path(dir_home, "Analysis/output_results")
dir_output = file.path(dir_home, "R_output")

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(dir_output)) {dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE)}
```

# +++ Load data

## Metadata

```{r}
## ______________________________________________________
# Load metadata
tab_metadata = readxl::read_excel(file.path(dir_home, "metadata.xlsx"))
```

## List of files

```{r}
## ______________________________________________________
# List raw segmentation data files
list_of_files_phase = list.files(dir_input, pattern = "RESULTS_PHASE")
list_of_files_dapi = list.files(dir_input, pattern = "RESULTS_DAPI")
list_of_files_gfp = list.files(dir_input, pattern = "RESULTS_GFP")
list_of_files_txred = list.files(dir_input, pattern = "RESULTS_TxRed")
```

## Load raw data

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Function: load and combine data for all files
# -----------------------------

## ******************************************************************************
func_read_data_phase = function(file_list) {
  # Initialize list to store data for all files
  all_file_data_list = list()
  
  # Loop through files
  for (file in file_list) {
    
    # get run name from file and remove "_stack.tif.csv" from the end
    run_name = gsub("_stack.tif.csv", "", file)
    
    # Extract run number from file name as the last three characters of run_name
    run_number = as.numeric(substr(run_name, nchar(run_name)-2, nchar(run_name)))
    
    # read csv style data
    data = read.csv(file.path(dir_input, file))
    
    # rename x column as id
    data = data %>% dplyr::rename(RUN.object = X)
    
    # add run number to data
    data = data %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(RUN = run_number) %>% 
      dplyr::select(RUN, everything())
    
    # add data to list
    all_file_data_list[[run_name]] = data
  }
  
  # Combine all data into a single data frame
  df_phase = dplyr::bind_rows(all_file_data_list)
  
  # Arrange data by run
  df_phase = df_phase %>% dplyr::arrange(RUN)
  
  return(df_phase)
}
## ******************************************************************************
```

```{r}
## ******************************************************************************
func_read_data_gfp = function(file_list) {
  file_list_lenght = length(list_of_files_gfp)
  all_file_data_gfp_list = list()
  
  for (file in list_of_files_gfp) {
    run_name = gsub("_stack.tif.csv", "", file)
    run_number = as.numeric(substr(run_name, nchar(run_name)-2, nchar(run_name)))
    data = read.csv(file.path(dir_input, file))
    data = data %>% 
      dplyr::rename(RUN.object = X,
                    Area.gfp = Area,
                    Mean.gfp = Mean)
    data = data %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(RUN = run_number) %>% 
      dplyr::select(RUN, everything())
    all_file_data_gfp_list[[run_name]] = data
  }
  
  df_gfp = dplyr::bind_rows(all_file_data_gfp_list)
  df_gfp = df_gfp %>% dplyr::arrange(RUN)
  
  return(df_gfp)
}
## ******************************************************************************
```

```{r}
## ******************************************************************************
func_read_data_txred = function(file_list) {
  file_list_lenght = length(list_of_files_txred)
  all_file_data_txred_list = list()
  
  for (file in list_of_files_txred) {
    run_name = gsub("_stack.tif.csv", "", file)
    run_number = as.numeric(substr(run_name, nchar(run_name)-2, nchar(run_name)))
    data = read.csv(file.path(dir_input, file))
    data = data %>% 
      dplyr::rename(RUN.object = X,
                    Area.txred = Area,
                    Mean.txred = Mean)
    data = data %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(RUN = run_number) %>% 
      dplyr::select(RUN, everything())
    all_file_data_txred_list[[run_name]] = data
  }
  
  df_txred = dplyr::bind_rows(all_file_data_txred_list)
  df_txred = df_txred %>% dplyr::arrange(RUN)

  return(df_txred)
}
## ******************************************************************************
```

```{r}
## ______________________________________________________
# Read and combine data for all channels
df_phase = func_read_data_phase(list_of_files_phase)
df_gfp = func_read_data_gfp(list_of_files_gfp)
df_txred = func_read_data_txred(list_of_files_txred)

df_combined = df_phase %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(df_gfp, by = c("RUN", "RUN.object")) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(df_txred, by = c("RUN", "RUN.object")) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(tab_metadata, by = c("RUN" = "run"))
```

# +++ Data analysis

## Base directories

```{r}
## ______________________________________________________
# Set home directory
dir_home = "~/directory"

# Set data directories
dir_input = file.path(dir_home, "R_output")
dir_output = file.path(dir_home, "R_output")

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(dir_output)) {dir.create(dir_output, recursive = TRUE)}
```

## Data analysis

```{r}
# show distribution of all area values combined
ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = Area)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1) +
  theme_minimal()
```

According to the histogram, we will filter out all area values below 0.5 µm^2 and exclude any images with errors in segmentation (Pixel data created big boxed instead segmented bacterial cells).

```{r}
df_filtered = df_combined %>% 
  filter(
    Area > 0.5,
    ) %>% 
  filter(is.na(exclude.segm))
  
```

## R. intestinalis

```{r}
plot_data = df_filtered  %>% 
  filter(DRUG.name %in% c("BA-14", "BA-6", "DMSO")) %>%
  group_by(DRUG.name, bio.rep) %>% # Summarise area by biological replicate
  summarise(Area = mean(Area), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(DRUG.name = recode(DRUG.name,
                            "BA-14" = "Taurolitocholic acid",
                            "BA-6" = "Taurochondeoxycholic acid",
                            "DMSO" = "DMSO"
                            )) %>%
  mutate(DRUG.name = factor(DRUG.name, levels = c(
    "DMSO",
    "Taurochondeoxycholic acid",
    "Taurolitocholic acid"
  )))

# writexl::write_xlsx(plot_data %>% mutate(STRAIN.name = "Roseburia intestinalis"), file.path(dir_home, "SUPP_TABLE_Microscopy_Area_Rint.xlsx"))

n_bacteria = df_filtered %>% 
  filter(DRUG.name %in% c("BA-14", "BA-6", "DMSO")) %>%
  group_by(DRUG.name) %>% # count number of bacteria per treatment
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(DRUG.name = recode(DRUG.name,
                            "BA-14" = "Taurolitocholic acid",
                            "BA-6" = "Taurochondeoxycholic acid",
                            "DMSO" = "DMSO"
                            ))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = DRUG.name, y = Area, fill = DRUG.name)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, width = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.5), size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 21) +
  geom_text(data = n_bacteria, aes(x = DRUG.name, y = max(plot_data$Area)*1.05, label = paste0("n=", n)), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 2, angle = 45) +
  ggpubr::stat_pwc(
    method = "tukey_hsd",
    label = "p.adj.format",
    tip.length = 0,
    label.size = 2,
    y.position = max(plot_data$Area)*1.1,
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Taurolitocholic acid" = "gold2",
    "Taurochondeoxycholic acid" = "#578B21",
    "DMSO" = "white"
  ),
    name = "Treatment"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "R. intestinalis",
    x = "", 
    y = "Mean Area µm^2"
    ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    #axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    legend.position = "none"
    )

p1 = last_plot()

## ______________________________________________________
# Save plot
##egg
plot_egg = egg::set_panel_size(last_plot(), 
                               width  = unit(40, "mm"),
                               height = unit(40, "mm"))

ggsave(filename = file.path(dir_output, "Microscopy_Area_Boxplot Rint.jpg"),
       plot = plot_egg,
       width = 160,
       height = 180,
       unit = "mm",
       dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = file.path(dir_output, "Microscopy_Area_Boxplot Rint.pdf"),
       plot = plot_egg,
       width = 160,
       height = 180,
       unit = "mm",
       dpi = 300)

```
